rule: No drug or medical claims. Do not say a product treats, cures, prevents or heals a condition, or that it regrows hair, stops hair loss or treats dandruff or eczema.
Do not claim FDA approval or any regulator's endorsement.
Performance claims must match the product's approved claims exactly. Do not reword, strengthen or invent one.
Objective or measurable claims, such as a duration, a percentage, 'clinically tested' or 'repairs', need substantiation on file. The reviewer must confirm it.
No unsupported superlatives or rankings, such as best, #1, top rated or guaranteed.
Do not mention or depict competitors or other brands.
No prices, discounts, shipping offers, or time-sensitive promotions in images or listing copy.
Only reference ingredients shown on the pack or in approved product data.
